messages:
maria: FYI vendor NightHawk scheduled penetration test for staging next Wed 08:30 PST. They requested: ephemeral KMS wrapping proof, 100% audit capture for stack traces, and a signed evidence bundle after retest. Need ops + security alignment today.
lucas: Re: KMS 11 11 prefer we do not share key material. We can give them a signed VerifyKeyBlob response from our HSM and let them call our kms-proxy. @devops can we emit an attestation artifact?
devops: yes, HSM can produce a signed key-wrapping cert (pkcs7). We'll provision an engagement wrapping-key with alias alias/pt-1769998123 and set key policy to allow kms-proxy:Encrypt only. No Decrypt permissions for assessors.
oncall: I'll own bridge and paging for the day. add me to runbook.
maria: RBAC plan: create group=pt-night-hawk, role=pt-assessor-readonly. Policy minimal: S3 read on staging-buckets, CloudWatch Logs read, and invoke on kms-proxy. No IAM:PassRole.
lucas: sample IAM snippet for the role: ```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": ["s3:GetObject","s3:ListBucket"],
      "Resource": ["arn:aws:s3:::redwood-staging/*", "arn:aws:s3:::redwood-staging"]
    },
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": ["logs:DescribeLogGroups","logs:GetLogEvents"],
      "Resource": "*"
    },
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": ["execute-api:Invoke"],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:apigateway:us-west-2::/restapis/kms-proxy/*"
    }
  ]
}
```
maria: add note: role sessions must be limited to 4 hours and require MFA. Tag sessions with engagement=pt-1769998123.
sec-bot: Automated check 11 11 Detected: staging bucket has public ACL? false. Evidence export policy binding OK.
lucas: Audit logging: set sampling=100% for token-trace and kinesis ingest for Wed-Thu window. Have log-processor add field penetration_test_id: pt-1769998123 and platform.trace_id. Persist full traces to s3://pt-evidence/pt-1769998123/ with server-side KMS=alias/pt-1769998123.
devops: we'll enable log-processor filter and a high-IO retention policy (90d hot, 365d cold). We'll also create a read-only snapshot every 6 hours during the window and sign each snapshot manifest with the HSM key: `openssl dgst -sha256 -sign /etc/hsm/pt_key.pem manifest.json | base64`.
assessor-bot: Vendor asked for a pre-engagement dry-run to validate evidence flow. Recommended steps: 1) get ephemeral creds, 2) call kms-proxy for GenerateDataKeyEncrypted, 3) fetch logs, 4) request presigned export.
maria: Retest plan: vendor to request retest slots in JIRA epic PT-176999 (I'll create). Tentative retest dates: next Mon/Tue. Make them aware we may route to dedicated pool and throttle throughput.
lucas: Evidence signing: after dry-run we'll produce manifest.json with checksums and sign via HSM. Example manifest entry: `{\"path\": \"logs/2026-03-25/trace-0001.json.gz\", \"sha256\": \"...\" }`. We'll include timestamped signature and the public cert chain.
\oncall: I'll add the runbook link and bridge URL to the calendar invite. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/pen-testing/night-hawk-pt-1769998123
maria: Remediation tracking: create Jira epic PT-176999 and three components: critical/high/med. SLA: Critical=7d, High=21d, Med=45d. Assign remediation-squad as default. Please include proof-of-fix steps and test vectors.
devops: small blocker: infra rotation policy requires an infra-owner sign-off for creating alias/pt-1769998123. Who's on infra? @kelly?
lucas: pinged kelly DM. If no sign-off by 17:30 we'll spin up a timeboxed alias with explicit TTL and audit annotation.
maria: final ask: any blockers on KMS attestation, RBAC, log retention, or export flow before 17:00?
oncall: none from oncall; bridge ready.
sec-bot: Reminder 11 11 policy-run scheduled at 17:00. Post-policy snapshot will land at s3://pt-audit-snapshots/pt-1769998123/ if checks pass.
lucas: I'll draft the public cert chain and HSM signing commands in the runbook. maria please confirm the epic name once it's created.
maria: EPIC created: PT-176999 (https://jira.redwood.com/browse/PT-176999). tagging remediation-squad. Will update here after infra sign-off. :eyes:
